romania-transfagarasan.slogan: Curtea de Arges to Cartisoara · one way, about 151 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Curtea de Arges
waypoints.advice: Curtea de Arges is where the day begins. Next is Vidraru Dam.

waypoints.name: Vidraru Dam
waypoints.advice: Vidraru Dam comes up 50 km in. Next is Balea Lake.

waypoints.name: Balea Lake
waypoints.advice: 101 km in you reach Balea Lake. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Cartisoara, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Cartisoara
waypoints.advice: Cartisoara closes the day.

sections.advice: Curtea de Arges → Vidraru Dam is 32 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Vidraru Dam → Balea Lake climbs about 2042 m in 33 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Balea Lake → Cartisoara drops about 2042 m over 17 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Transfagarasan Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: For 58 km this is Transfagarasan Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Transfăgărășan
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 61 km. 2042 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.

scenicChapters.title: Transfăgărășan
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2042 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

romania-transfagarasan.story: From Curtea de Argeş it runs 151 km to Cârţişoara; allow about 2 h 02 of riding. The stops in between: Vidraru Dam and Balea Lake. The highest point is about 2,050 m. Balea Lake is open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
